coordinate_convention: integer semi-open xywh boxes; pooled object center is center of its visible pooled extent, not latest raw center
calibration_rule: each type >=50 jointly visible pairs, >=99% presence agreement, >=99% boxes within1pixel on each edge
temporal_checks: saved wrapper pool byte-identical to max(last2raw); RAM pair captured without intervening act; reset refreshes raw pair from new episode
failure_policy: record failed development baseline; change only a separate pooled adapter on development, seal before17022; thresholds and raw decoder unchanged
agent_access: semantic masks, RAM, fixtures and calibration outputs remain exclusively experimenter-side
